page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, centred on the page; page number and running head at the top; no notes in the margins (the right edge shows show-through from the facing page, which is left out); the digitiser's banner at the foot is left out.

main_text.p: pta, videatur Artem imitari voluisse: Quomodo minimas aliquas nivium quisquilias, in elegantissimas stellulas crenat & circinat, mille gyris & spiris marinas conchas exsculpit, mille modis Tulipa-rum flores, pavonum caudas, colla columbarum distinguit.

At vero, si animum attendi-mus, sunt alia non pauciora, quæ tumultuariâ quadam confusione & maligna specie terrent nos & turbant: Sunt cancri & araneæ, sunt fœto-res tetri, sunt horribiles ulu-latus, sunt noctypni lemures, qui diro mentem nostram percellunt phantasmate: Cur igitur Naturam Rerum egregiè

page.notes: Right-hand margin shows only show-through from the facing page and is not transcribed. Doubtful: "noctypni" in the scan reads "nocturni" (the printed form is nocturni). Line "egregiè" is set on a separate line at the right, partly raised.
